home.about_desc_sre_id: Society of Renewable Energy (SRE) Indonesia is the national student organization uniting university chapters across Indonesia in the mission to accelerate the country's clean energy transition. Through education, research, and community action, we drive the clean energy revolution.
home.about_desc_sre_upnvjt: SRE UPN Veteran Jawa Timur is a collaborative student chapter under SRE Indonesia based in Surabaya. Since 2021, we have been empowering students through hands-on clean energy campaigns, professional research projects, and community technology deployments.
home.activity_desc: From research to community impact explore what SRE UPN JATIM does on the ground.
home.testimonials_desc: Hear directly from members about their learning journey, growth, and team experiences at SRE UPNVJT.
home.partners_desc: Organizations, institutions, and communities we work with to accelerate the sustainable transition.
home.campus_audit_desc: Conducting electrical consumption analysis and building-level energy efficiency studies.
home.re_project_desc: Hands-on solar and wind energy installation projects for communities.
home.study_discussion_desc: Weekly internal knowledge-sharing sessions on renewable energy topics.
home.social_project_desc: Community service initiatives focused on energy access for underserved areas.
home.external_events_desc: Participating in national and international renewable energy competitions and conferences.
home.events_programs_desc: Explore the diverse initiatives SRE UPN JATIM drives on the ground, ranging from interactive workshops and seminars to field campaigns.
home.featured_projects_desc: Discover SRE UPN Veteran Jawa Timur's upcoming events, seminars, and initiatives. Get ready to be part of the clean energy transition!
home.projects_coming_soon_desc: We are preparing our next exciting initiatives. Stay tuned to this page so you don't miss out!

about.hero_title: Accelerating energy transition through student innovation
about.hero_desc: Society of Renewable Energy (SRE) UPN "Veteran" Jawa Timur is a student organization dedicated to driving clean energy transition and acceleration.
about.vision_desc: To become the primary hub and center of excellence for students of UPN "Veteran" Jawa Timur in the development of science, technology, and real action in the clean energy sector to realize a sustainable future for Indonesia.
about.mission_1: To increase awareness & literacy of energy transition among students and the broader public.
about.mission_2: To organize impactful and appropriate renewable energy research and projects.
about.mission_3: To build synergetic collaborations across sectors: academia, industry, and community.
about.pillars_desc: The main framework of SRE UPNVJT in driving tangible impact in campus environments and society.
about.pillar_edu_desc: Providing high-fidelity training, seminars, and workshops to elevate renewable energy literacy among students.
about.pillar_tech_desc: Developing practical, scalable microgrid, solar power, and bioenergy prototypes for real-world application.
about.pillar_env_desc: Promoting sustainability, decarbonization models, and eco-friendly community waste management.
about.pillar_emp_desc: Collaborating with local villages to implement renewable energy grids directly elevating their socioeconomic level.
about.structure_desc: SRE UPNVJT operates through six focused divisions, each responsible for a critical pillar of our movement.
about.connect_desc: Connect with us for discussions on partnership, sponsorship, media, or simply exchanging insights on alternative energy.
